description: Verify a whole day of the claim ledger against its stamped Merkle root, no transaction needed. Returns every committed claim of the day (the leaves), the root recomputed live from them, the root stamped on Solana, whether they match, the anchoring transaction and the treasury wallet that must have signed it. verify_claim answers whether one payout is in the ledger; this answers whether the ledger itself is intact. Omit the period to audit the most recent stamped day, which makes it suitable for continuous monitoring. The guarantee is on-chain, not this response: rebuild the root from the returned leaves and check that the memo read from Solana is exactly vaultbags:claims:v1:<day>:<claims that day>:<root>, in a transaction signed by the VaultBags treasury (a wallet you hold fixed, not one this response names) that landed after that day ended.

period.description: UTC day as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the latest stamped day.

name: verify_day
